Trajx WASM - Cable-Aware Motion Planning Demo

This demo showcases cable-aware motion planning that tracks and constrains cable twist during robot motion.

CableConfig API

1. Cable Configuration

// Create cable config with builder pattern const config = new CableConfig() .withMaxTotalTwist(4 * Math.PI) .withWarningThreshold(0.75) .withAutoUnwind(true);

2. Cable Presets

// Use preset configurations const standard = cablePresetStandard(); // 4π const heavy = cablePresetHeavyDuty(); // 2π const light = cablePresetLight(); // 8π const precision = cablePresetPrecision();// 2π + unwind

CableTracker API

3. Twist Tracking

// Create tracker and update twist const tracker = new CableTracker(config); tracker.updateTwist(Math.PI); console.log(tracker.currentTwist); console.log(tracker.remainingBudget);

4. Path Analysis

// Analyze path for twist const analysis = tracker.analyzePath( pathFlat, dof, fkCallback ); console.log(analysis.finalTwist); console.log(analysis.twistProfile);

CableAwarePlanner API

5. Cable-Aware Planning

// Plan with cable constraints const planner = new CableAwarePlanner( jointLimits, cableConfig ); const result = planner.plan( start, goal, currentTwist, fkCallback );

6. Planning with Collision Check

// Plan with collision checking const result = planner.planWithCollisionCheck( start, goal, currentTwist, collisionChecker, fkCallback );

Twist Limit Scenarios

7. Warning Zone Detection

// Test warning zone (75% of limit) config.isTwistWarning(twist); tracker.isInWarningZone();

8. Twist Budget Exhaustion

// Simulate multiple motions for (motion of motions) { if (!tracker.isWithinLimits()) { console.log("Cable limit reached!"); break; } }

Integration: Multi-Segment Cable Tracking

// Track cable across multiple motion segments const tracker = new CableTracker(cablePresetStandard()); for (const segment of segments) { const result = planner.plan(segment.start, segment.goal, tracker.currentTwist, fk); if (result.success) { tracker.updateTwist(result.finalTwist - tracker.currentTwist); console.log(`Segment done. Twist: ${tracker.currentTwist}rad`); } if (tracker.isInWarningZone()) { console.warn("Approaching cable limit!"); } }
